notes.title: Maid Cafe Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the official release date for upcoming adult game Maid Cafe... You can look forward to playing the game in full on the 25th August 2023. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/3fe6184f9887899da32c04fb0feb4f501d8f5dc5.png[/img]

Make sure you wishlist the game now to be notified on release, so that you can enjoy the biggest game we have published. Maid Games have done an amazing job with the development of this game.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/28b5f5aa9e28f131d54905c498d548df9af977b9.png[/img]

It features almost half a million words of dialogue and scripting, over 35 characters to meet and have sexy fun with, plus over 1000 adult illustrations to unlock and enjoy, plus the chance to explore the town, buy items from shops, visit local destinations, go on dates, practice your desserts, learn new recipes and compete in a bake off competition!

Wishlist it now and don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/423640/Maid_Cafe/

Deluxe Bundles and Discounts available on release, the game also comes with trading cards and Achievements to unlock.

Plus more, check it out today to try your hand at our new Magical Title.

notes.title: V1.5 Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that the full kinetic graphic novel of Keiji Light has now been released as part of the Echo Tokyo: Intro version 1.5 update.

This update includes the entire kinetic graphic novel of Keiji Light, which has every line fully voice acted by professionals as it was with the Shizume origin story.

In addition we have added a new achievement for reading the Keiji origin story.

This tells a darker story and gives more insights into the games setting.

In addition the new story adds a new page to the image database within the game, bringing the total amount of images to unlock up to 160.

The store page has also been updated accordingly.
